evaluation_context: healthy adults, single oral dose, immediate-release, fasted-state reference records
not_intended_for: clinical DDI, PGx, PKPD, or MIPD decisions

independent_external_holdout.reason: No outcome-blinded set remains unconsumed, and one active fitted model still lacks SHA-pinned training membership.

retrospective_development_benchmark.classification: repeatedly used for system selection; exact disjointness from shipped-model training cannot be independently verified

consumed_temporal_challenge.classification: consumed; historical 2026-07-05 system, not re-scored after the public-only fup, Peff, Cmax, and CLint retrains

uncertainty.warning: The residual interval is not independent split-conformal calibration. The two interval sources answer different questions and must not be conflated.

applicability.ad_flags_are: structural applicability indicators, not validated error probabilities
